productionEvidenceBoundary.native: Actual OUTCOME exports only native.integrity and cases(id,status), not child TAP. OWN verifies that finite safe projection is an exact structural ordered selected-ID prefix and enforces N2. It never parses/authenticates absent RAW TAP of the actual run. Synthetic raw TAP may check model consistency as DATA, never a Source62a oracle or actual native evidence.
productionEvidenceBoundary.journal: Recompute safe published contiguous events/frontier/firstThrow under accepted rules. For a clean journal verify canonical NDJSON bytes/hash; unexported torn/invalid suffix has only bounded producer-observed raw digest. Do not claim proof of those missing bytes.
productionEvidenceBoundary.target: Before/after13 targethash observations are checked against immutable normal13 and DATA tree; correctness of real measurement comes from pinned producer+Root review/custody. No new raw target/TAP/DTO fields or exports are proposed.
productionEvidenceBoundary.outcomeMeaning: diagnosticCollectionComplete means custody/reporting succeeded; nativeQualification:false is mandatory. Child timeout/failure can coexist with valid collection; infrastructure faults cannot.

coreSemantics.events: Independent per-case action enter→return|throw, count enter→return|throw; advance only on counted pair. AFTER close is independent at most one enter/exit and may interleave. Seq1contiguous/+1 and elapsed0..330000nondecreasing; exact finiteerror/siteallowlist; no arbitrary reordering or skipped records.
coreSemantics.missingWorld: Existing D07 assertion occurs before action mark for later missingworld cases, and count is skipped if world never exists. A truthful journal prefix can therefore remain before count while native FAILs continue; never invent markers or force native/journal cardinalities to match.
coreSemantics.firstThrow: Earliest edge throw in validated contiguous exported prefix, including AFTER, or null. Primitive null/undefined thrown values retain a throw edge with nullable projected details. Unknown tail prevents claims about absolute/physical first/last, not retention of already observed prefix.
coreSemantics.unknownVsFault: Stable empty/torn/invalidrecord/observedrecorderflag produces exact UNKNOWN reason and suppressed openCase/afterOpen sentinels, previousvalidrows retained. Root contract priority RecorderFault > invalidcomplete > torn > empty. Unstable identity/read, wrong executing alias/pin, custody/target drift, N2 or publication errors are FAULT; no accepted pair/artifact.
coreSemantics.N1: Actual raw API unique terminal job and actual logical fourthcommand step; five exact stepnames/order,repo/event/ref/message/head/parent/tree/attempt1. Strict realUTC dates (not NaN or impossible calendar), one header+closed group, exact two markers within command±1000ms, no smuggled/duplicate/mixed family marker even outside window. No hardcoded hosted stepnumber.
coreSemantics.N2: For each observed nativePASS, a reliable validated action/count throw of SAME selected id is a fatal contradiction, even if later journaltail is unknown. NativeFAIL with returns is allowed. Independent globalAFTER or anotherID throw does not contradict that namedPASS.
coreSemantics.nativeProjection: empty=>0pairs; exact contiguous selected-ID prefix, no duplicates/foreignnames/order recovery. Proposed schema has prefix/empty/torn/ambiguous only; prefix20 is allowed without promoting native qualification/complete TAP totals. Do not copy oldN3 native.complete cardinality rules into this family.
coreSemantics.sourceReads: Use two independent real13canonicalTARGET measurements. Do not compare proposed canonicalS08/S09 to GitBASE or fill arrays fromSourceIndex. Both hashes must match normal13 in index order and roottarget flags; rawGit checks exact inertDATA edges and baselinepreservation separately.
coreSemantics.externalAndZip: Keep current419 raw archive-byte/CRC/full-deflate/DD/TLV/noZIP64/version/size/name/digest checks and strict API/tree/log bounds. New family context, role manifests and two frames must be explicitly sealed; no outcome-controlled expected source/selection/admission.
coreSemantics.emptyStreams: Zero-byte stdout/stderr (and any equal-length empty canonical journal prefix) must use exact SHA256(empty). APIjob span stays<=420000ms; child180/case120/total330 remain sealed producer/procedure limits, not invented timing fields or inference from a stdout hash.
coreSemantics.faultEnvelope: Use exact e55 phaseReasons and post-admission context/nullability semantics when retaining failed occurrences; no structurally valid FAULT is accepted as completed collection.

families.label: KNOWN_ACTION_OPEN
families.facts: Trusted prefix ends on actual action-enter; timeout capture and shorter independent native prefix.
families.expect: Admit diagnostic; recompute action frontier; no inferred physical await/root cause.

families.label: KNOWN_COUNT_OPEN
families.facts: Action settled then count-enter without exit.
families.expect: Admit count frontier; preserve actual last native pair independently.

families.label: BETWEEN_ACTION_COUNT
families.facts: Action settled, world missing or no later count marker; later native FAILs may exist.
families.expect: Do not fabricate count call or skip interval to recover later; recorded gap is not proof physically blocked.

families.label: AFTER_OVERLAP
families.facts: AFTER.close starts while action/count remains open, settles in either order allowed by chronological journal.
families.expect: Recompute case-and-after/open flags from observed events.

families.label: COMPLETE_TIMEOUT
families.facts: All20 action/count plus AFTER returned; child ETIMEDOUT.
families.expect: post-teardown-process-exit; no live-handle/SDK/process cause claim.

families.label: COMPLETE_THROW_TIMEOUT
families.facts: Same complete event set with any throw, including AFTER.
families.expect: post-settlement-process-exit; preserve earliest validated throw.

families.label: NORMAL_END
families.facts: Valid complete or honest prefix evidence with native exit0/1, no signal/error; all external collection gates hold.
families.expect: NativeQualification/SourceQualified/Task1Pass remain false even all20 native PASS.

families.label: FIRST_THROW_PRECEDENCE
families.facts: Action throws, counter later also throws; nullable error details include original null/undefined thrown values.
families.expect: Earliest throw pointer refers to first recorded edge, not last throw/non-null details; no Native PASS sameid.

families.label: AFTER_THROW_NAMED_PASS
families.facts: Named native cases PASS, independent AFTER throws and child exits1.
families.expect: Valid diagnostic; AFTER is not same-case N2 contradiction.

families.label: NATIVE_FAIL_WITH_RETURNS
families.facts: Action/count returned but native FAIL from framework/outside markers.
families.expect: Allowed; never infer PASS from returns or require recorded throw for every native FAIL.

families.label: EMPTY_UNKNOWN
families.facts: Stable owned zero-byte journal, independent nonempty/empty native evidence.
families.expect: UNKNOWN/JOURNAL_EMPTY; empty is not zero activity.

families.label: TORN_UNKNOWN
families.facts: Stable invalid last byte fragment after valid complete rows; actual rawlength exceeds prefix.
families.expect: UNKNOWN/JOURNAL_TORN, valid prefix and firstthrow retained; no absolute last-event claim.

families.label: MALFORMED_RECORD_UNKNOWN
families.facts: Stable raw row with malformed site/illegal transition; earlier valid prefix only exported.
families.expect: UNKNOWN/JOURNAL_INVALID_RECORD; malformed row must not be published inside witness.events.

families.label: RECORDER_FLAG_UNKNOWN
families.facts: Stable read and observed flag, possibly with torn/invalid suffix.
families.expect: UNKNOWN/RECORDER_FAULT priority; valid earlier prefix+TAP remain independent.

families.label: UNKNOWN_REASON_PRIORITY
families.facts: Recorderflag+invalid/torn, invalidcomplete+torn, empty combinations.
families.expect: Exact contract priority; do not accept arbitrary reason/integrity/frontier combinations.

families.label: UNKNOWN_RAW_HASH

families.expect: Equal lengths require exact digest; torn/invalid tail requires rawlength>prefix and no fabricated full-hash equality.

families.label: N2_ACTION_PASS_CONFLICT

families.expect: FAULT/EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, not accepted UNKNOWN.

families.label: N2_COUNT_PASS_CONFLICT

families.expect: FAULT even if later frontier UNKNOWN; preserve earlier trustworthy throw.
